title: Walking in Divine Power
scripture_text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
lesson_one_line: Creation is waiting for the sons of God to manifest divine power in daily life.
group_question: What is one area of your life where creation is waiting for the son or daughter of God in you to manifest? Share it in the family group before you pick your assignment below.
full_word_paragraphs: With power, you become an enviable personality and will not be ashamed to be called the child of God. You must desire to walk in power. The first thing Jesus restored was power. Power is one of the proofs that Jesus Christ is real; your prosperity is tied to it. The level you will reach in life is based on the power at work in you.

To fulfill destiny, you need to be empowered and you need divine power to actualize divine plan. For every open door, there is an adversary. God told Moses, "tell Pharaoh let my people go" but Pharaoh was skeptical until God showed His power.

Forces will challenge you but be equal to the task. That God said you will be a great man is not automatic; you need power to overcome challenges of life. The enemy will always stand in the way of divine plan; that is why you must grow in divine power.
I declare in the Name of Jesus Christ, that every "rod of the wicked" opposing your inheritance and breakthrough is destroyed now by the power of God. Amen.
Good morning… Pp. Jesus is coming soon. "LET'S REPENT." Graceful day.
declaration: I declare in the Name of Jesus Christ, that every rod of the wicked opposing my inheritance and breakthrough is destroyed now by the power of God. I am a son / daughter of God, and creation is waiting for me to manifest. I will walk in divine power today. Amen.
prayer: Father, empower me by Your Spirit to walk out my assignment today. Let Your power be seen in my words, my work, and my witness. In Jesus' name, Amen.

teen.explanation: Creation itself is waiting to see God's children walk in real power — not loud or showy power, but the quiet strength to do the right thing when it's hard. In school, in your group chat, at home — the world is watching to see if Jesus is real in you. Divine power is what helps you say no when everyone else says yes, and yes to God when it feels lonely.
teen.verse_mini: "…the manifestation of the sons of God."
choices: Speak respectfully to my parent even if I disagree.
Say a short prayer before I open my phone in the morning.
Finish my schoolwork or chore without being reminded.
Encourage one classmate or sibling with kind words.

young.explanation: Your generation carries destiny — career, marriage, ministry, purpose. But every open door has an adversary. God won't hand you your inheritance while you're passive. You need divine power to push through resistance at work, in relationships, and in your prayer life. Don't just want the promise; grow in the power that carries it.
young.verse_mini: Creation is waiting for you to walk it out.
choices: Pray 15 minutes before starting work or class today.
Finish one task I've been avoiding — no excuses.
Speak one bold declaration over my day out loud.
Reach out to one person who needs encouragement.

older.explanation: You've carried responsibilities long enough to know some doors don't open without a fight. Divine power is what keeps you steady when work pressure, family strain, or health challenges come. Don't rely only on experience — depend on the power of God. The people around you (children, coworkers, church) are waiting to see a son or daughter of God who still walks in strength.
older.verse_mini: Manifest — don't just remember — who you are in Christ.
choices: Lead my family in one short prayer today.
Handle one work situation with patience instead of frustration.
Speak life over my children or spouse before bed.
Read Romans 8 aloud tonight and declare it over my house.

retired.explanation: Retirement is not the end of your assignment — it's a new season of power. You have time, wisdom, and a prayer voice that heaven still listens to. The rod of the wicked cannot silence you. Your intercession, your example, and your blessing over the family are the manifestation the next generation needs to see.
retired.verse_mini: You still shine as a son or daughter of God.
choices: Pray by name for each of my children and grandchildren today.
Call or message one family member with a Scripture blessing.
Spend 30 quiet minutes in worship this morning.
Share one testimony of God's power with someone younger.
